system.description:
Trigger: A spell, power or gloom ability targets you, or an area that includes you.
You catch the weave and throw it back. Test Sanity (DR18).

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the turned ability deals 2x damage.
outcomes.success: The ability does not affect you. Instead, it affects its user, or another target of your choice within its range.
outcomes.failure: The ability is not turned, but you take only half of its damage.
outcomes.ruin: The weave tangles around you: you take the ability as if you had rolled a Ruin to defend against it.
